_notes: Paste each object in the 'functions' array into Vapi's Assistant > Functions config (or via the Vapi API when creating the assistant). 'server.url' should point to your webhook (mocked endpoints are fine for the demo — e.g. a simple Express/FastAPI app or a request-bin style mock that returns canned JSON). Every tool has a 2s client-side timeout and 1 retry per the HLD (§5).

functions.name: verify_customer
functions.description: Verify the caller's identity against the account on file before any account or debt information may be disclosed. Must be called before get_account_details.

phone_number.description: The phone number the call is connected to, in E.164 format.

spoken_dob.description: Date of birth as stated by the caller, normalized to YYYY-MM-DD.

spoken_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the loan account or PAN reference as stated by the caller. Optional if pincode is provided instead.

spoken_pincode.description: Registered pincode as stated by the caller. Optional if last4 is provided instead.

customer_id.description: Present only if match is true.

functions.name: get_account_details
functions.description: Fetch the customer's current loan/EMI details. Only callable after verify_customer has returned match:true for this call (server enforces this — do not call before authentication succeeds).

functions.name: log_promise_to_pay
functions.description: Log a customer's commitment to pay by a specific date/amount. Idempotent per (loan_id, call_id) to avoid duplicate PTPs on retried turns.

functions.name: send_payment_link
functions.description: Send a payment link to the customer via SMS or WhatsApp. Should generally be called after log_promise_to_pay succeeds, or during an already-paid verification flow if a residual amount remains.

functions.name: escalate_to_agent
functions.description: Hand off the case to a human collections agent. Used for hardship, disputes, ambiguous authentication, abusive callers, technical failures, or explicit customer request to speak to a person.

transcript_summary.description: Brief paraphrased summary for the human agent, not a verbatim transcript dump.

functions.name: mark_disposition
functions.description: Log the final outcome of the call. MUST be called exactly once before every call ends, regardless of outcome.

functions.name: check_call_window
functions.description: Pre-dial guard (called by the dialer/pipeline before connecting, not mid-conversation) to confirm the call is within permitted hours and the number isn't on the do-not-call list.
